description: This file defines classes for executing script transformations within Apache Spark SQL, including the main execution class SparkScriptTransformationExec and a helper thread class SparkScriptTransformationWriterThread. It manages running external scripts, processing input/output data, and integrating with Spark's execution plan.

classes.name: SparkScriptTransformationExec
classes.description: Executes a script transformation by forking an external process, passing input data, and reading output data within Spark's execution plan.

classes.name: SparkScriptTransformationWriterThread
classes.description: A thread class responsible for writing input rows to the external script process.

methods.name: processIterator
methods.description: Sets up the external process, input/output streams, and starts the writer thread to process input rows.

methods.name: withNewChildInternal
methods.description: Creates a new instance of SparkScriptTransformationExec with a different child plan.
